besluite.fout: 'albei' has only one named party before it (the family); the other side of the trade is implied, so a Grade 5 reader has to work out who 'albei' are.
besluite.rede: 'albei kante' is the natural Afrikaans way to name both sides of a trade, it fixes the missing referent without changing who did what, and one added two-syllable word in a text averaging 1.51 moves the syllables-per-word figure by only about 0.003, which keeps it under the 1.52 ceiling.
